company.name: Bitrise
company.shortDescription: Bitrise is a mobile DevOps platform built to adress mobile’s challenges, empowering mobile teams to deliver their best work.
company.description:
Bitrise is a platform for mobile app development, enabling tens of thousands of developers to automate integration, testing, and deployment. Through 200+ integrations with the services developers know and love, Bitrise frees up developers to iterate and improve their workflows for ever faster and better results. It offers more than 300 steps and integrations to easily connect the processes and services you use in your mobile development workflows.

With tens of thousands of developers and customers spanning unicorn startups (Careem, Traveloka) to established enterprise companies (Virgin, TNT), Bitrise is the defacto standard for mobile CI/CD and automation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $60,000,000, or 71.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,386,327 to $379,629,200, a 273.84x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
